info.title: CloudWatch Logs Fetcher
info.description: Fetches and filters application logs from AWS CloudWatch Logs

get.description: Searches CloudWatch Logs for entries matching a filter pattern within a time range. Use this when the user asks about errors, exceptions, warnings, or any application-level issues visible in logs. Available log groups: /eks/telugu-pickles/pods (us-east-1) for JSON application logs from the Telugu Pickles microservices (gateway, auth-service, catalog-service, cart-service, order-service, payment-service). Each line has service, level, msg and requestId fields; filter with patterns like ERROR, "payment declined", or a requestId to trace one request across services, /aws/eks/telugu-pickles-eks/cluster (us-east-1) for Kubernetes control plane logs, /app/production (us-east-1) for synthetic demo logs.

parameters.name: filter_pattern
parameters.description: The search pattern to filter logs. Examples: ERROR, 503, timeout, connection refused, OutOfMemory, Unauthorized, Failed

parameters.name: log_group_name
parameters.description: The CloudWatch Log Group name. Use /eks/telugu-pickles/pods for Telugu Pickles pod logs. Use /aws/eks/telugu-pickles-eks/cluster for Kubernetes control plane logs. Use /app/production for synthetic demo logs.

parameters.name: hours_back
parameters.description: How many hours back to search. Use 1 for recent issues, 6 for trends, 24 for daily patterns.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: AWS region where the logs are stored. Use us-east-1 for EKS pod logs (/eks/telugu-pickles/pods) and control plane logs (/aws/eks/telugu-pickles-eks/cluster). All log groups are in us-east-1.
